sources.title: 金士頓標下力晶生產線 力成、品安受惠
sources.locator: Article body, paragraph beginning “金士頓將後段封測訂單…”
sources.note: Reports DRAM modules were to be contract-manufactured by 品安 for Kingston; does not rank Kingston against other customers.

sources.title: 金士頓撐腰 品安上季獲利超預期
sources.locator: Article body, paragraph beginning “金士頓2012年7月…”
sources.note: Describes Kingston as a major shareholder and major customer, and says DRAM modules and SSDs were outsourced to 品安; does not state Kingston was the largest OEM customer.

sources.title: 大客戶結束代工！品安11月將裁員250名
sources.effective_period: Customer activity from 2023; announced end date 2024-11-30
sources.locator: Article body, paragraphs beginning “品安下午召開重大訊息記者會…” and “品安表示…”
sources.note: Reports 品安’s disclosure that an unnamed customer had reduced outsourcing since 2023 and would end all contract manufacturing on 2024-11-30. The customer is not named, so this cannot establish that it was Kingston.

sources.title: 金士頓取得品安3席董事
sources.locator: Article body, paragraph beginning “為確保代工產能無虞…”
sources.note: 中央社 report says Kingston subscribed to a private placement, held over 20% and became 品安’s largest institutional shareholder.

sources.title: 品安兩大利空衝擊股價跳空跌停 記憶體族群同步走跌
sources.note: Reports, citing Market Observation Post System data, that Kingston held 1,969 lots of 品安 shares, a 3.23% stake, at September 2024 month-end.

sources.title: 品安法人董事轉讓持股低於當選時持股數二分之一自然解任（issuer notice republished by CNA/Yahoo）
sources.note: Identifies 美商 KINGSTON TECHNOLOGY CORPORATION as the former corporate director and says its director seat terminated after share transfers reduced its holding below half the amount held at election. It does not state the remaining holding or a complete divestment.

search_notes: Isolated Hermes Agent run using gpt-6-luna with xhigh reasoning and web tools.

Focused searches found historical evidence of Kingston’s customer and shareholder relationships, but no period-specific customer ranking and no current shareholding confirmation. Unresolved scope and denominator gaps remain.
The customer-ranking claim lacks a defined period, customer-ranking basis, and revenue denominator; no market-share denominator or units apply to this customer-ranking assertion.
Secondary reports document historical Kingston outsourcing and shareholder relationships, but do not establish the exact “largest OEM customer” ranking.
品安’s 2024 disclosure about the departing OEM customer did not name that customer. Identifying it as Kingston would go beyond the disclosure.
The 2024 director notice establishes a transfer threshold and removal from the board, not Kingston’s remaining shareholding or present-day shareholder status.
